Create the graph shown and discuss the following questions: - What kind of chart is used in the figure? - What geometries have been used and to which variables have these geometries been mapped? - Based on this graph, do you think gender plays a role in salaries? What is the trend you see? - If SALARY, NO_OF_WORKERS, GENDER, OCCUPATION were available in the original dataset, what pre-processing would have been necessary to obtain this plot?
